title: PBS ION demo test vectors
description: Envelope, MUX, PBS-AUTH-01 and PBS-SEC-B-01 vectors for the PBS ION demo. Rules: docs/SPEC-DIGEST.md. All byte strings are lowercase hex. Times are Unix epoch microseconds unless a field name says otherwise. Keys in sec_b.test_keys are TEST KEYS, derived from public labels, and must not be used outside this demo.
